reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 4 points better, in a game of about 212 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Spurs.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 66 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 186 and 234 total points.
